capabilities: Render interactive recipe blocks from a fenced kitchenforge YAML block
Compute dependent ingredient amounts from id/calc ratio expressions, including a per-mille @ operator
Scale fixed recipes via multiplier buttons applied to the original amounts
Switch between interchangeable recipe variants with choice groups and a show-all toggle
Copy the currently displayed recipe as a Markdown list
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a food-safety warning that its example curing numbers are not a tested standard. Requires Obsidian 1.2.3+; works on desktop and mobile.
motivation: The author makes sausage at home (ratio-based dosing against meat weight) and also cooks fixed-list recipes, and needed both workflows in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian renders recipes as plain text, so changing a base weight or scaling a fixed ingredient list means manually recalculating every amount.
summary: Fenced code block renderer that turns recipes into interactive calculators with ratio-based computation, one-click scaling, and variant switching.
